subject: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & stakeholder handshake (Helios Health)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@helioshealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & stakeholder handshake (Helios Health)

Hi Sofia and Tom,

Thanks again for your time yesterday — excited to get Helios set up for a quick evaluation of Redwood Inference. I wanted to put a short, actionable kickoff note in the thread so we have agreed goals, owners, and a tentative timeline to work against. I attached a draft MAP (Helios-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf).

High-level goals we heard:
- Validate latency and throughput on representative EHR prompt workloads (primary success metric: P95 latency < 250ms for 128-token prompts)
- Confirm cost and scaling profile for our typical batching patterns
- Surface any data residency / security artifacts required for pilot approval

Proposed 30-day evaluation timeline (flexible):
1) Week 0 (this week): Finalize MAP owners and kickoff call.
2) Week 1: Infrastructure onboarding (API keys, test dataset, security questionnaire).
3) Week 2: Performance runs + baseline metrics.
4) Week 3: Quality checks and small integration smoke tests.
5) Week 4: Review findings, decision meeting, and next-steps (pilot or expand).

Owner ask: can you confirm a single champion and a technical contact from Helios who will be the day-to-day for test requests? I suggest: Sofia as champion and Tom as technical lead — please confirm or update.

Security & procurement note: Marissa will own the security questionnaire and evidence tracking (cc’d). Rishi will coordinate pricing/commit details once you confirm timeline.

Next steps:
- Sofia/Tom: confirm champion & tech contact, and whether the timeline above looks OK.
- Helios: share any must-have dates (compliance windows / board reviews).

Attachments: Helios-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf (draft mutual action plan)

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
(+1) 415-555-0182
From: Sofia Patel <sofia.patel@helioshealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@helioshealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & stakeholder handshake (Helios Health)

Thanks, Ava — this looks great and mirrors what we discussed. Confirming: I’ll be the champion and Tom will be our technical lead. I’m also looping in two additional stakeholders who should see the MAP and join any technical kickoff: Dr. Maya Rios (clinical safety) and Alex Carter (security/compliance).

Quick items from our side:
- We have a compliance review window the week of Sep 13 — would prefer most evidence for security to be available before then.
- We can start test traffic the week of Sep 6.
- On latency: 250ms P95 is reasonable as a target to validate; if you can surface token-level cost estimates in the MAP that will help procurement.

On the attachment: I reviewed the draft MAP and left a couple of comments (I’ll send a marked-up copy separately).

Appreciate the clear owners. I’m available for a 20-min technical sync Mon Sep 6 at 10am PT if that works for Tom and your team.

— Sofia
Sofia Patel
Director of Product, Helios Health
sofia.patel@helioshealth.com

Subject: Re: Kickstart: Evaluation roadmap & stakeholder handshake (Helios Health)

Thanks for the quick confirmation, Sofia — that works. I updated the MAP (v1) to reflect the champion/tech owners and added a short section with token-cost examples per 1k requests (see attached). I’ll send the marked-up copy separately if you prefer comments inline.

Notes and adjustments based on your constraints:
- We’ll aim to have security artifacts ready for your Sep 13 compliance window — Marissa will start the evidence collection tomorrow.
- Test traffic: we’ll schedule the initial run for Sep 6. Can Tom confirm whether he prefers a short smoke test first or full-scale perf runs?
- Technical sync: Sep 6, 10am PT works for our team — I sent a calendar invite to everyone in this thread.

Attachments: Helios-MAP-Draft-v1.pdf (updated with owners), security-contacts.csv

Best,
Ava
